_readme: One entry per template. 'fields' lists every id the generation engine should treat as a data-binding target — i.e. text to replace or an image to inject. Purely decorative/structural ids (gradients, clip-paths, corner ornaments, wrapper groups, static design labels) are intentionally excluded; the SVGs contain many more ids than are listed here, and that's expected. type 'text' = replace element's text content. type 'image' = set the element's image href to the uploaded file, scaled to fit its bounding box. 'image_target_id' (new): when an image field's id sits on a wrapping <g> rather than directly on the <image> element that carries the href, this names the actual <image> id to write to — render.js falls back to field.id when this is absent. 'reposition_sibling_if_empty' (new): { "id": "<element-id>", "transform": "<svg transform>" } — when this field is left blank, applies that transform to the named sibling element (e.g. sliding a lone remaining signature block to center once its counterpart's hide_container has removed it). required=false fields may be left blank/skipped per FR-2.7 (optional fields render blank, template layout never shifts).

templates.name: Exclusive Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Aug 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block' — the seal artwork is wrapped in <g id="seal-block">, confirmed present. FIX (Sep 2026): the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line, the course-title line, and the program-dates paragraph were all left-anchored in an earlier revision to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so all three were restored to centered. Also FIX: award-year previously had a hardcoded '20' prefix (Presented this Day day of Month, 20YY) which combined with a full 4-digit year typed by the user to read '202026' — award-year now expects and holds the complete year.

templates.name: Modern Excellence
templates.notes: No course-title or start-date/end-date fields by design — treated as a general achievement award, not tied to a specific course or date range. FIX (Aug 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block', confirmed present. FIX (Sep 2026): the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line was left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so it was restored to centered. Also FIX: award-year previously had a hardcoded '20' prefix, same issue and same fix as Exclusive Completion.

templates.name: Premium Training
templates.notes: FIX (Aug 2026): award-date-line split into separate award-day/award-month/award-year fields; SVG's signature-1/signature-2/opt-seal-slot groups given real <image> elements so uploads and hide_container actually work. FIX (Sep 2026): logo-slot's identical missing-<image> bug fixed the same way — logo uploads now actually render. Granted line restored to centered (confirmed safe against real production output). NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(1754,2245) — the block already carries its own translate transform, so this must be the full target position, not a delta) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Certificate of Excellence
templates.notes: Same as Modern Excellence — no course-title or date-range fields by design. FIX (Sep 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block' — the SVG already had that wrapping group around the decorative medallion, it just wasn't referenced here. Also FIX: the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line was left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so it was restored to centered. NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(304,0) — this block had no prior transform, so this is a pure offset, unlike Premium Training/Dulux Completion which needed the full target position) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Classic Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Sep 2026): both opt-logo-slot and opt-seal-slot had a real, working <image> element and wrapping decorative group already in the SVG — but the field id sat on the wrapping <g>, while the actual <image> carrying the href used a different id (logo-image / seal-image respectively). Uploads were silently being written to the group (no visual effect) instead of the image. Added image_target_id to point at the real image elements, and hide_container so the whole decorative frame (not just the image) disappears when nothing is uploaded, matching every other template's behavior.

templates.name: Dulux Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Sep 2026): logo-slot, signature-1, signature-2 and opt-seal-slot were all <g> groups containing only decorative artwork and placeholder text, with no actual <image> element at all — no institution had ever been able to get a logo or custom seal onto this template, and uploads had no element to write to. Real <image> elements were added, clipped to the existing circles, with wrapper groups renamed to logo-slot-block/signature-1-block/signature-2-block/seal-block. opt-seal-slot now declares hide_container: 'seal-block' to match. Also FIX: the program-dates paragraph's first line and the 'Granted this Day day of Month, Year' line were left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so both were restored to centered. NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(1754,2245) — full target position, same reasoning as Premium Training, since this block also already carries its own translate transform) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Global Spec
templates.notes: REPLACED (Sep 2026): the previous file was a raw CorelDRAW export that could not have worked as a template — none of its 16 text elements carried ids, every font-family was a bare named font with no generic fallback, and there were zero <image> elements for logo/signature/seal. Rebuilt with ids matching this schema, font-family fallbacks added, and logo-slot/signature-1/signature-2/opt-seal-slot <image> elements added, clipped to the design's existing circular/underline placeholder art. CANVAS SIZE DIFFERS from every other template (11693x8268, not 3508x2481). FIX (centering): institution-name, opt-subtitle, recipient-name, course-title, signature-1-caption, signature-1-title, opt-signature-2-caption, and opt-signature-2-title had no text-anchor at all — Corel exports default to left-anchored, positioned to LOOK centered only for the exact placeholder text. All eight now explicitly center-anchor (the four signature fields center on their own signature block, not the canvas) regardless of replacement length — confirmed against real production data where shorter real names/titles were rendering visibly shifted left. FIX (signature-image gap): signature-1 and signature-2 now use preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet" (bottom-aligned) instead of "xMidYMid meet" (centered), so an uploaded signature photo's ink sits close to the underline regardless of blank margin the org's own photo may have above it. FIX (date-field overflow, now dynamic): start-date, end-date, award-day, award-month, and award-year declare "fit_width" (see render.js's fit_width doc comment) instead of a hand-picked static font-size — render.js now measures each value's actual rendered width against the real bundled font at generation time and shrinks only as much as that specific value needs, never more. Fields are back at their template's natural font-size (180.56px date-range, 195px day/month/year) in the SVG itself; the shrinking happens per-certificate, not per-file. award-day/award-month/award-year's fit_width values are measured directly from the template's own blank-line underline polygons (335.83 / 617.73 / 389.82 canvas units — solid, geometry-derived numbers). start-date/end-date have no equivalent underline to measure from (that line is inline sentence text, not a blank-fill style) — their fit_width of 780 is a tested-good estimate (verified against "MARCH 4TH"/"MARCH 16TH" and the worst realistic case "SEPTEMBER 1ST"/"SEPTEMBER 30TH", both clean with no warnings) rather than a geometric fact like the other three; watch the [render] fit_width warning logs on this template for a few weeks in case a genuinely unusual value needs it nudged wider. This REQUIRES render.js to have the fit_width/fontkit support added and the fontkit package installed — a template-file-only deploy is not enough for this template. FIX (visual consistency, Sep 2026): award-day/award-month/award-year, and separately start-date/end-date, now declare a shared "fit_group" ("granted-date" and "program-dates") so render.js sizes every field in a group identically -- the smallest size any member needs -- instead of each field shrinking independently and ending up visibly different sizes next to each other in the same sentence. This also closed up the last remaining tight/touching gaps (e.g. "6THday") since the shared size is never larger than the most-constrained field's own requirement. Months are also now expected as the approved abbreviation for any month over 5 letters (Jan./Feb./Aug./Sept./Oct./Nov./Dec. -- March/April/May/June/July stay unabbreviated) -- enforce this at the generation-form level (a 12-value dropdown, not a character-limited text box, so a long month can't be silently truncated to something wrong) rather than relying on fit_width/fit_group to carry it alone; those remain as the safety net, not the primary control. FIX (signature still sitting high above its line, Sep 2026): preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet" alone only aligns the UPLOADED IMAGE's own edge to the line -- if the org's photo has blank/transparent margin around the actual ink (very common with an uncropped phone photo or scan), that margin is still part of "the image" and the gap remains no matter how the box is positioned. signature-1 and signature-2 now declare "trim_image": true, which makes render.js crop that margin away (via sharp's trim()) before the image is embedded at all, so whatever the org uploaded, the box hugs the actual ink. Not applied to logo-slot/opt-seal-slot -- those often carry intentional padding as part of the mark itself, which trimming would wrongly strip. trim_threshold (30, same as before) is now read from here rather than hardcoded in render.js -- if the trim isn't aggressive enough (or too aggressive) once tested against a real signature upload, this is the number to change; no render.js edit or redeploy needed for that adjustment. REBUILT (Sep 2026, structural fix): 'Granted this Day day of Month, Year' and 'conducted from X to Y covering' were baked vector-path artwork for the static words ('Granted', 'this', 'day', 'of', 'from', 'to', 'covering') with only the values as separate fixed-position live text -- the actual root cause of every date-field overlap/shrink issue on this template. Identified the exact baked paths by isolating and rendering each one individually (11 paths = 11 words, confirmed one-word-per-path, safely removable without touching neighboring lines), deleted them, and rebuilt both lines as single flowing <text> elements with inline <tspan id="..."> fields (matching the same technique the other templates already use, e.g. Certificate of Excellence's 'Presented this <tspan>Day</tspan> day of...' line) -- text-anchor="middle" on the whole sentence, so the browser's own text layout reflows it automatically regardless of value length. fit_width/fit_min_font/fit_group REMOVED from these 5 fields -- no longer meaningful now that there's no fixed-width blank to fit into, and leaving them would make render.js incorrectly try to shrink text against a constraint that no longer exists. Verified with full month names and full dates ("September 1st, 2026" to "September 30th, 2026", "31st day of September, 2026") at natural, unshrunk size -- no overlap, no manual sizing needed at all, matching how every other template already behaves.

templates.name: Executive Completion
templates.notes: REPLACED (this update): swapped in a new SVG design (see the file's own header comment for the full change log). institution-name and opt-subtitle are independent top-level elements, not nested inside logo-block, so hide_container:'logo-block' only ever hides the optional logo circle — required org-name text is unaffected either way. No start-date/end-date fields — course-title stands alone, not tied to a date range, so those two fields were dropped from the previous entry (the new SVG has no matching elements; leaving them in would keep prompting for input that goes nowhere). ADDED hide_placeholder: 'signature-1-placeholder' — missing from the previous entry, so the dashed placeholder box and 'Signature (PNG)' label never hid once a real signature was uploaded; now they do. opt-logo-slot and opt-seal-slot remain pure optional image slots with no baked fallback artwork (hide_container removes the whole frame when empty), matching Modern Excellence / Certificate of Excellence.
